source.text: אֵ֣ת כָּל־הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אֹת֥וֹ תִשְׁמְר֖וּ לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת לֹא־תֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔יו וְלֹ֥א תִגְרַ֖ע מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Every the word which I [am] commanding you, it you shall be careful to do; not you shall add to it, and not you shall take away from it.

en.L: Every word that I am commanding you, you shall be careful to do it; you shall not add to it, and you shall not take away from it.
en.B: Be careful to do everything I command you. Do not add to it or take anything away from it.
en.R: Be careful to obey everything I command you. Do not add anything to it, and do not take anything away from it.

es.L: Toda palabra que yo {{plural_you:les|os}} mando, {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} cuidado de hacerla; no añadirás a ella, y no quitarás de ella.
es.B: {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} cuidado de hacer todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando. No le añadas nada ni le quites nada.
es.R: {{plural_you:Obedezcan|Obedeced}} con cuidado todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} mando. No le agregues nada, y no le quites nada.

fr.L: Toute parole que je vous commande, vous veillerez à la pratiquer ; tu n’y ajouteras pas et tu n’en retrancheras pas.
fr.B: Veillez à mettre en pratique tout ce que je vous commande. N’y ajoute rien et n’en retranche rien.
fr.R: Obéissez avec soin à tout ce que je vous commande. N’y ajoute rien, et n’en enlève rien.

sw.L: Kila neno ninalowaamuru, mtaliangalia kulitenda; usiongeze juu yake, wala usipunguze kutoka kwake.
sw.B: Kuweni waangalifu kutenda kila kitu ninachowaamuru. Usiongeze kitu wala usipunguze kitu.
sw.R: Kuweni waangalifu kutii kila kitu ninachowaamuru. Usiongeze chochote, wala usiondoe chochote.

vi.L: Mọi lời ta truyền cho các ngươi, các ngươi phải cẩn thận làm theo; ngươi không được thêm vào, và không được bớt đi.
vi.B: Hãy cẩn thận làm theo mọi điều tôi truyền cho anh em. Không được thêm vào hay bớt đi điều gì.
vi.R: Hãy cẩn thận vâng giữ mọi điều tôi truyền cho anh em. Đừng thêm điều gì vào, cũng đừng bớt điều gì ra.

ko.L: 내가 너희에게 명령하는 모든 말, 그것을 너희는 지켜 행하여라. 너는 거기에 더하지 말고, 거기에서 빼지도 말아라.
ko.B: 내가 너희에게 명령하는 모든 것을 지켜 행하여라. 거기에 아무것도 더하지 말고, 거기에서 아무것도 빼지 말아라.
ko.R: 제가 여러분에게 명령하는 모든 것을 잘 지키십시오. 거기에 무엇을 더하지도 말고, 거기에서 무엇을 빼지도 마십시오.

pt.L: Toda palavra que eu lhes ordeno, vocês terão o cuidado de cumpri-la; não lhe acrescentarás nada, e não lhe tirarás nada.
pt.B: Tenham o cuidado de cumprir tudo o que eu lhes ordeno. Não lhe acrescentes nada nem lhe tires nada.
pt.R: Tenham o cuidado de obedecer a tudo o que eu ordeno a vocês. Não acrescentes nada e não tires nada.

am.L: የማዝዛችሁን ቃል ሁሉ እርሱን ታደርጉ ዘንድ ተጠንቀቁ፤ በእርሱ ላይ አትጨምር፤ ከእርሱም አታጉድል።
am.B: የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ በጥንቃቄ አድርጉ። ምንም አትጨምሩበት፤ ምንም አታጉድሉበትም።
am.R: የማዝዛችሁን ሁሉ በጥንቃቄ ፈጽሙ። ምንም ነገር አትጨምሩበት፤ ምንም ነገርም አትቀንሱበት።

decisions.choice: verse numbers: in many Bibles this verse is 12:32
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text this verse opens chapter 13; many Bibles number it 12:32, the last verse of chapter 12, and so number the rest of this chapter (13:2-19 here) 13:1-18. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: the verse looks both back and forward: it closes the laws on worship in chapter 12 and introduces the warnings against those who would add other gods
alternatives: a closing summary of chapter 12 only
decisions.reason: The command to do all that Moses commands sums up the laws on the one place of worship in chapter 12, and it also sets the standard by which the prophets, dreamers and tempters of this chapter are to be judged: no sign or voice may add to or take from what the LORD has commanded. The chapter division of the Hebrew text joins it to what follows; other Bibles join it to what precedes.

decisions.choice: do not add to it or take from it: the same warning as 4:2
decisions.reason: Moses gave the same warning in 4:2 at the start of his teaching. The words he passes on from the LORD are complete; no one may change them by adding new commands or dropping old ones. Proverbs 30:6 gives a similar warning about God's words.

decisions.choice: you all, then each of you: the address moves from plural to singular
decisions.reason: "You shall be careful" addresses the people as a group; "you shall not add" and "you shall not take away" address each one, or the nation as one person. Deuteronomy often moves between the two without a change of meaning.

decisions.choice: everything
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "everything" for "every word": the noun here means each thing commanded, the whole of the instruction. Literal keeps "every word".

decisions.choice: vocês (be careful) ... tu (do not add, do not take away)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from the plural to the singular in this verse (m4). Literal follows it word by word; Balanced and Readable follow it sentence by sentence, as the English Balanced and Readable already divide it, so that each sentence keeps one form of address (6:1).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; the pronouns for God are the ordinary ones ("እርሱ", "ትእዛዛቱ").

decisions.choice: Literal keeps the change from plural "ተጠንቀቁ" to singular "አትጨምር ... አታጉድል"; Balanced and Readable keep the plural through the verse
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the address moves from all of you to each of you. Amharic marks the number on every verb; as in chapter 12, Balanced and Readable keep one number within a sentence or verse where the change would jar.

source.text: כִּֽי־יָק֤וּם בְּקִרְבְּךָ֙ נָבִ֔יא א֖וֹ חֹלֵ֣ם חֲל֑וֹם וְנָתַ֥ן אֵלֶ֛יךָ א֖וֹת א֥וֹ מוֹפֵֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: If arises in your midst a prophet or a dreamer of a dream, and he gives to you a sign or a wonder,

en.L: If there arises in your midst a prophet or a dreamer of dreams, and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
en.B: Suppose a prophet or someone who has dreams appears among you and announces to you a sign or a wonder,
en.R: A prophet or someone who has dreams may come among you. He may promise you a sign or a miracle.

es.L: Si se levanta en medio de ti un profeta o un soñador de sueños, y te da una señal o un prodigio,
es.B: Supongamos que surge en medio de ti un profeta o alguien que tiene sueños y te anuncia una señal o un prodigio,
es.R: Puede ser que llegue a ti un profeta o alguien que tiene sueños. Quizá te prometa una señal o un milagro.

fr.L: S’il se lève au milieu de toi un prophète ou un rêveur de songes, et qu’il te donne un signe ou un prodige,
fr.B: Si un prophète ou quelqu’un qui a des songes surgit au milieu de toi et t’annonce un signe ou un prodige,
fr.R: Un prophète ou quelqu’un qui a des songes viendra peut-être chez toi. Il te promettra peut-être un signe ou un miracle.

sw.L: Akiinuka katikati yako nabii au mwota ndoto, naye akakupa ishara au ajabu,
sw.B: Tuseme nabii au mtu anayeota ndoto ametokea kati yako, akakutangazia ishara au ajabu,
sw.R: Huenda nabii au mtu anayeota ndoto akaja kwako. Huenda akakuahidi ishara au muujiza.

vi.L: Nếu giữa ngươi nổi lên một nhà tiên tri hay một kẻ nằm mơ thấy chiêm bao, và người ấy đưa ra cho ngươi một dấu lạ hay một điềm lạ,
vi.B: Giả sử giữa anh em có một nhà tiên tri hay một người hay nằm mơ xuất hiện và báo trước cho anh em một dấu lạ hay một điềm lạ,
vi.R: Có thể một nhà tiên tri hay một người hay nằm mơ đến giữa anh em. Người ấy có thể hứa cho anh em một dấu lạ hay một phép lạ.

ko.L: 너희 가운데 예언자나 꿈꾸는 자가 일어나서 너에게 표적이나 이적을 보이고,
ko.B: 너희 가운데 어떤 예언자나 꿈을 꾸는 사람이 나타나서 너희에게 표적이나 이적을 예고하고,
ko.R: 어떤 예언자나 꿈을 꾸는 사람이 여러분 가운데 나타날 수도 있습니다. 그가 여러분에게 표적이나 기적을 약속할 수도 있습니다.

pt.L: Se se levantar no meio de ti um profeta ou um sonhador de sonhos, e te der um sinal ou um prodígio,
pt.B: Suponhamos que apareça no meio de ti um profeta ou alguém que tem sonhos e te anuncie um sinal ou um prodígio,
pt.R: Pode ser que um profeta ou alguém que tem sonhos apareça no meio de ti. Ele pode te prometer um sinal ou um milagre.

am.L: በመካከልህ ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ቢነሣ፣ ምልክትን ወይም ድንቅን ቢሰጥህ፣
am.B: በመካከልህ ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ተነሥቶ ምልክት ወይም ድንቅ እንደሚሆን ቢነግርህ፣
am.R: ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ወደ መካከልህ ሊመጣ ይችላል። ምልክት ወይም ተአምር እንደሚያሳይህ ቃል ሊገባልህ ይችላል።

decisions.choice: verse numbers: many Bibles begin chapter 13 here
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. Many Bibles count the verse before this one as 12:32 and begin chapter 13 here, so 13:2-19 here is 13:1-18 there. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: a dreamer of dreams: someone who claims to receive messages from God in dreams
decisions.reason: God did speak to prophets in dreams (Numbers 12:6), and dreams carried messages in the stories of Joseph (Genesis 37:5-11; 41). So a dreamer could claim the same standing as a prophet. The phrase is the Hebrew way of naming a person by what he does.

decisions.choice: gives a sign or a wonder: foretells an event or works a marvel that seems to prove his message
decisions.reason: A "sign" is something that points to and confirms a message; a "wonder" is a startling event (6:22; 28:46; Exodus 7:3, 9). Here the prophet "gives" the sign by announcing it, as verse 3 shows ("the sign ... which he spoke to you").

decisions.choice: if: the start of a case that runs to verse 6
decisions.reason: The word opens a case law: the condition is set out in verses 2-3, and what Israel must do follows in verses 4-6. Two more cases follow in the same pattern (verses 7-12 and 13-19).

decisions.choice: announces
decisions.reason: Balanced says "announces" for "gives", since the sign is something foretold (verse 3). Literal keeps "gives"; Readable says "promise".

decisions.choice: miracle
decisions.reason: Readable says "miracle" for "wonder", the common word for an amazing event that seems to come from a higher power.

decisions.choice: "un rêveur de songes" (L); "quelqu'un qui a des songes" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Rêveur" alone suggests a daydreamer in French; Literal keeps the Hebrew pairing with "songes", Balanced and Readable say what the person does.

decisions.choice: "mwota ndoto" (L, B); "mtu anayeota ndoto" (R)
decisions.reason: "Mwota ndoto" is the ordinary Swahili noun for one who dreams dreams; Readable spells it out.

decisions.choice: "예언자"; "꿈꾸는 자" (L) / "꿈을 꾸는 사람" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "예언자" as the Korean style guide settles (the older "선지자" is the alternative).

decisions.choice: "kẻ nằm mơ thấy chiêm bao" (L), "người hay nằm mơ" (B, R) for the dreamer of dreams
decisions.reason: One who claims messages from God in dreams; Readable uses "phép lạ" for the wonder, as the English Readable says "miracle".

decisions.choice: um sinal ou um prodígio (L, B); um sinal ou um milagre (R)
decisions.reason: "Sinal" for the sign that confirms a message (m3), "prodígio" for the startling event, as Exodus 7:3, 9 have them in Portuguese; Readable says "milagre", as the English Readable says "miracle" (r-en-2). The verses speak to Israel in the singular, so every level says "tu".

decisions.choice: "ሕልም አላሚ" for "a dreamer of dreams"; "ምልክት" and "ድንቅ" (L, B), "ተአምር" (R) for "sign" and "wonder"
decisions.reason: Kept through verses 2-6. Readable says "miracle" as the English does.

source.text: וּבָ֤א הָאוֹת֙ וְהַמּוֹפֵ֔ת אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖יךָ לֵאמֹ֑ר נֵֽלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יְדַעְתָּ֖ם וְנָֽעָבְדֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and comes the sign and the wonder which he spoke to you, saying, let us go after other gods, which not you have known them, and let us serve them,

en.L: and the sign and the wonder come [about] of which he spoke to you, saying, 'Let us go after other gods'—which you have not known—'and let us serve them,'
en.B: and the sign or wonder he told you about comes true, and he says, 'Let us follow other gods'—gods you have not known—'and let us worship them,'
en.R: And the sign or miracle may really happen. Then he says, 'Let us follow other gods and worship them.' These are gods you have not known.

es.L: y se cumple la señal y el prodigio del cual te habló, diciendo: “Vayamos tras otros dioses” —que no has conocido— “y sirvámoslos”,
es.B: y la señal o el prodigio que te anunció se cumple, y él dice: “Sigamos a otros dioses” —dioses que no has conocido— “y adorémoslos”,
es.R: Y quizá la señal o el milagro suceda de verdad. Entonces él dice: “Sigamos a otros dioses y adorémoslos”. Son dioses que no has conocido.

fr.L: et que le signe et le prodige dont il t’a parlé arrive, en disant : “Allons après d’autres dieux” — que tu n’as pas connus — “et servons-les”,
fr.B: et que le signe ou le prodige qu’il t’a annoncé se réalise, et qu’il dise : “Suivons d’autres dieux” — des dieux que tu n’as pas connus — “et adorons-les”,
fr.R: Et le signe ou le miracle arrivera peut-être vraiment. Alors il te dira : “Suivons d’autres dieux et adorons-les.” Ce sont des dieux que tu n’as pas connus.

sw.L: na ile ishara na ajabu aliyokuambia ikatokea, akisema, 'Na tuifuate miungu mingine'—ambayo hukuijua—'na tuitumikie,'
sw.B: na ile ishara au ajabu aliyokuambia ikatimia, naye akasema, 'Tuifuate miungu mingine'—miungu ambayo hukuijua—'na tuiabudu,'
sw.R: Huenda ishara au muujiza huo ukatokea kweli. Kisha anasema, 'Tuifuate miungu mingine na kuiabudu.' Hiyo ni miungu ambayo hukuijua.

vi.L: và dấu lạ hay điềm lạ mà người ấy đã nói với ngươi xảy đến, [rồi người ấy] nói: 'Chúng ta hãy đi theo các thần khác'—là các thần ngươi chưa biết—'và chúng ta hãy phụng sự chúng,'
vi.B: và dấu lạ hay điềm lạ người ấy báo trước xảy ra đúng như vậy, rồi người ấy nói: 'Chúng ta hãy đi theo các thần khác'—những thần anh em chưa từng biết—'và hãy thờ phụng chúng,'
vi.R: Và dấu lạ hay phép lạ ấy có thể xảy ra thật. Rồi người ấy nói: 'Chúng ta hãy đi theo các thần khác và thờ lạy chúng.' Đó là những thần anh em chưa từng biết.

ko.L: 그가 너에게 말한 그 표적이나 이적이 이루어지고, 그가 '우리가 다른 신들을 따라가자' —너희가 알지 못하던 것들이다— '그리고 우리가 그것들을 섬기자' 하고 말하더라도,
ko.B: 그가 말한 표적이나 이적이 실제로 이루어지고, 그가 '다른 신들을 따르자' —너희가 알지 못하던 신들이다— '그리고 그 신들을 섬기자' 하고 말하더라도,
ko.R: 그리고 그 표적이나 기적이 정말 일어날 수도 있습니다. 그러고 나서 그가 '다른 신들을 따르고 섬기자' 하고 말할 수도 있습니다. 그 신들은 여러분이 알지 못하던 신들입니다.

pt.L: e vier o sinal e o prodígio de que ele te falou, dizendo: 'Vamos atrás de outros deuses' — que não conheceste — 'e sirvamos a eles',
pt.B: e o sinal ou o prodígio que ele te anunciou se cumprir, e ele disser: 'Vamos seguir outros deuses' — deuses que não conheceste — 'e adorá-los',
pt.R: E o sinal ou o milagre pode acontecer de verdade. Então ele diz: 'Vamos seguir outros deuses e adorá-los.' São deuses que não conheceste.

am.L: ስለ እርሱም፦ “ሌሎችን አማልክት እንከተል”—አንተ ያላወቅሃቸውን—“እናገልግላቸውም” ብሎ የነገረህ ምልክቱና ድንቁ ቢፈጸም፣
am.B: “ሌሎችን አማልክት እንከተል”—አንተ የማታውቃቸውን አማልክት—“እናምልካቸውም” ብሎ የነገረህ ምልክት ወይም ድንቅ ቢፈጸም፣
am.R: ያም ምልክት ወይም ተአምር በእርግጥ ሊፈጸም ይችላል። ከዚያም “ሌሎችን አማልክት እንከተል፤ እናምልካቸውም” ይልሃል። እነዚህ አንተ የማታውቃቸው አማልክት ናቸው።

decisions.choice: which you have not known: Moses' own comment, set inside the prophet's words
decisions.reason: The prophet would hardly call the gods unknown; the words "which you have not known" speak to Israel directly ("you") and break into the quoted invitation. They are Moses' remark on what the prophet is really offering. Verses 7 and 14 have the same aside.

decisions.choice: not known: not experienced; gods that have done nothing for Israel
decisions.reason: To "know" here is to know by experience. Israel knew the LORD through what he had done for them in Egypt and in the wilderness (11:2-7); these gods had shown them nothing (11:28; 32:17).

decisions.choice: go after: follow as a worshiper
decisions.reason: To "go after" a god is to follow him in loyalty and worship, as a servant walks behind his master (6:14; 8:19; 11:28). Verse 5 turns the phrase round: "after the LORD your God you shall walk".

decisions.choice: let us serve them: the verb has an unusual form
alternatives: let us be led to serve them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew vowels give the verb a rare form that may mean "let us be brought to serve them" or simply "let us serve them". Either way the sense is an invitation to worship these gods; the plain form appears in verses 7 and 14.

decisions.choice: follow; worship
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "follow" for "go after" and "worship" for "serve", the meaning of both phrases when they speak of gods. Literal keeps the Hebrew pictures.

decisions.choice: These are gods you have not known.
decisions.reason: Readable moves Moses' aside out of the quotation into a sentence of its own, so that it is clear the prophet is not the one saying it.

decisions.choice: — que não conheceste — inside the quotation (L, B)
decisions.reason: Moses' own comment breaks into the prophet's words (m1); Literal and Balanced set it off with dashes between the two parts of the quotation, as the English does, and Readable gives it a sentence of its own after the quotation (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: The comment "which you have not known" stands between dashes inside the speaker's words, splitting the quotation as the English does
decisions.reason: Moses' own aside interrupts the prophet's words (the meaning decision); the two parts of the quotation are kept as two quotations. Readable puts the comment after the quotation, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: the LORD is testing you: he lets the false prophet's sign happen to bring the people's loyalty to light
decisions.reason: The test does not mean the LORD leads anyone into evil. Even a sign that comes true does not make a message true when it calls Israel away from the LORD. As in the wilderness (8:2, 16) and later in the land (Judges 2:22; 3:4), such a trial shows whether their love is real.

decisions.choice: to know: to make known, to find out by the outcome
decisions.reason: The LORD already knows the heart; "to know" here means that the trial brings into the open what is in the people, as in 8:2.

decisions.choice: with all your heart and all your soul: with your whole mind and will, and your whole self and life
decisions.reason: The "heart" is the inner person, mind and will together; the "soul" is the whole living self. The pair repeats the great command of 6:5 (see also 10:12; 11:13): love for the LORD that holds nothing back.

decisions.choice: you shall not listen: even when the sign comes true
decisions.reason: The command comes after the case in verses 2-3 has been granted in full: the prophet speaks, the sign happens, and still he must not be heard. What he says, not what he can do, decides whether he is to be listened to (compare 18:21-22).

decisions.choice: that dreamer
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "that dreamer" for "that dreamer of the dream"; the shorter phrase names the same person introduced in verse 2.

decisions.choice: He wants to find out if you really love him
decisions.reason: Readable makes a new sentence and says "him" for the second "the LORD your God", which the Hebrew repeats. "Really" brings out the point of the test.

decisions.choice: singular "no escucharás", then plural "{{plural_you:los|os}} está probando"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses each hearer in "you shall not listen" and then the people as a whole; Spanish keeps the shift, as elsewhere in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: tu (do not listen) ... vocês (the LORD is testing you)
decisions.reason: The command is singular and the reason plural; Balanced and Readable give each its own sentence, as the English does, and keep the number of each.

decisions.choice: está pondo vocês à prova
decisions.reason: "Pôr à prova" says that the trial brings out what is in the people (m1, m2), without the sense of luring into evil that "tentar" can carry.

decisions.choice: "በሙሉ ልባችሁና በሙሉ ነፍሳችሁ" for "with all your heart and with all your soul"
decisions.reason: The wording of Deuteronomy 6:5 as Matthew 22:37 has it in Amharic ("በሙሉ ልብህ፣ በሙሉ ነፍስህ"), in the plural the Hebrew has here.

records.literal_gloss: After Yahweh your God you shall walk, and him you shall fear, and his commandments you shall keep, and to his voice you shall listen, and him you shall serve, and to him you shall cling.

en.B: It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God you must follow, and {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you must fear. Keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, serve {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and hold fast to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Follow only {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with awe. Obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands and listen to what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says. Worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and stay close to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

Hãy vâng giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và nghe theo lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán. Hãy thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và gắn bó với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 너희는 따라가고, 그분을 너희는 경외하고, 그분의 계명들을 너희는 지키고, 그분의 음성을 너희는 듣고, 그분을 너희는 섬기고, 그분께 너희는 붙어 있어라.
ko.B: 너희가 따를 분은 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시고, 너희가 경외할 분도 그분이시다. 그분의 계명을 지키고, 그분의 음성을 듣고, 그분을 섬기고, 그분께 꼭 붙어 있어라.
ko.R: 오직 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}만을 따르고, 그분을 두려워하며 공경하십시오. 그분의 명령을 지키고, 그분의 말씀을 들으십시오. 그분을 섬기고, 그분 곁을 떠나지 마십시오.

pt.L: Atrás {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, andarão, e a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} temerão, e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos guardarão, e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz ouvirão, e a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} servirão, e a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se apegarão.
pt.B: É {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que vocês devem seguir, e é a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} que devem temer. Guardem os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, ouçam a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} voz, sirvam a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e apeguem-se a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Sigam somente {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e honrem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}} com reverência. Obedeçam aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos e ouçam o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz. Adorem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e fiquem bem perto {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: አምላካችሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ትከተላላችሁ፤ እርሱንም ትፈራላችሁ፤ ትእዛዛቱንም ትጠብቃላችሁ፤ ድምፁንም ትሰማላችሁ፤ እርሱንም ታገለግላላችሁ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ትጣበቃላችሁ።
am.B: መከተል ያለባችሁ አምላካችሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ነው፤ መፍራት ያለባችሁም እርሱን ነው። ትእዛዛቱን ጠብቁ፤ ድምፁን ስሙ፤ እርሱን አገልግሉ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ተጣበቁ።
am.R: አምላካችሁን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ብቻ ተከተሉ፤ በፍርሃትም አክብሩት። ትእዛዛቱን ፈጽሙ፤ የሚላችሁንም ስሙ። እርሱን አምልኩ፤ ከእርሱም አትለዩ።

decisions.choice: the LORD and no other: each clause puts the LORD before the verb for emphasis
decisions.reason: In all six clauses the Hebrew puts "the LORD your God", "him" or "his" first. The order stresses that he alone is to be followed, set against the call to "go after other gods" in verse 3.

decisions.choice: fear: reverent awe that leads to obedience
decisions.reason: To fear the LORD is to honor him as God and to take his word seriously, not to live in terror of him. Deuteronomy pairs it with love and service (6:13; 10:12, 20).

decisions.choice: listen to his voice: obey him
decisions.reason: To "listen to the voice" of someone is to do what they say (verse 19; 15:5; 28:1). It is set against listening to the prophet in verse 4.

decisions.choice: cling to him: hold fast to him in loyalty
decisions.reason: The verb means to stick to or be joined to something. It describes the close loyalty Israel owes the LORD (10:20; 11:22; 30:20), the same word used of a man joined to his wife in Genesis 2:24.

decisions.choice: After the LORD your God you shall walk, and him you shall fear
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew order, with the object first, so the emphasis can be seen. Balanced shows it with "It is the LORD your God you must follow"; Readable with "only".

decisions.choice: Follow only; honor him with awe
decisions.reason: Readable adds "only" to bring out the emphasis of the Hebrew order, and says "honor him with awe" for "fear him", so that young readers do not hear it as being scared of God.

decisions.choice: Atrás do SENHOR ... andarão, e a ele temerão ...
decisions.reason: Literal keeps each object before its verb, as the Hebrew does for stress (m1); Balanced shows it with "É ... que", Readable with "somente", as the English does.

source.text: וְהַנָּבִ֣יא הַה֡וּא א֣וֹ חֹלֵם֩ הַחֲל֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יוּמָ֗ת כִּ֣י דִבֶּר־סָ֠רָה עַל־יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֜ם הַמּוֹצִ֥יא אֶתְכֶ֣ם׀מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם וְהַפֹּֽדְךָ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים לְהַדִּֽיחֲךָ֙ מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר צִוְּךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּ֑הּ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the prophet the that or the dreamer of the dream the that shall be put to death, for he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh your God, the [one] bringing out you from [the] land of Egypt and the [one] redeeming you from [the] house of slaves, to thrust you from the way which commanded you Yahweh your God to walk in it; and you shall purge the evil from your midst.

en.L: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death, for he has spoken rebellion against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slaves, to thrust you aside from the way in which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you to walk; so you shall purge the evil from your midst.
en.B: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he has urged rebellion against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery. He has tried to turn you aside from the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God commanded you to walk in. You must purge the evil from among you.
en.R: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death. He has told you to turn against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. He is the one who brought you out of Egypt and set you free from being slaves there. That man tried to lead you away from the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God told you to live. You must get rid of this evil among you.

es.L: Y aquel profeta o aquel soñador de sueños morirá, porque ha hablado rebelión contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, que {{plural_you:los|os}} sacó de la tierra de Egipto y te rescató de la casa de esclavos, para apartarte del camino por el cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te mandó andar; así quitarás el mal de en medio de ti.
es.B: Ese profeta o ese soñador será condenado a muerte, porque ha incitado a la rebelión contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}, que {{plural_you:los|os}} sacó de la tierra de Egipto y te rescató de la casa de esclavitud. Ha intentado desviarte del camino por el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te mandó andar. Eliminarás el mal de en medio de ti.
es.R: Ese profeta o soñador debe ser condenado a muerte. {{plural_you:Les ha dicho que se rebelen|Os ha dicho que os rebeléis}} contra {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su Dios|vuestro Dios}}. Él es quien {{plural_you:los|os}} sacó de Egipto y te libró de ser esclavo allí. Ese hombre intentó apartarte del camino que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te dijo que siguieras. Debes librarte del mal que hay entre los tuyos.

fr.L: Et ce prophète ou ce rêveur de songes sera mis à mort, car il a prêché la révolte contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, qui vous a fait sortir du pays d’Égypte et qui t’a racheté de la maison des esclaves, pour te détourner du chemin dans lequel {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a commandé de marcher ; et tu ôteras le mal du milieu de toi.
fr.B: Ce prophète ou celui qui a des songes devra être mis à mort, parce qu’il a prêché la révolte contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, qui vous a fait sortir du pays d’Égypte et qui t’a racheté de la maison d’esclavage. Il a cherché à te détourner du chemin où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a commandé de marcher. Tu feras disparaître le mal du milieu de toi.
fr.R: Ce prophète ou cet homme qui a des songes doit être mis à mort. Il vous a dit de vous révolter contre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui vous a fait sortir d’Égypte et qui t’a libéré de ton esclavage là-bas. Cet homme a essayé de t’éloigner du chemin que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’a dit de suivre. Tu dois te débarrasser du mal qui est chez toi.

sw.L: Na nabii yule au mwota ndoto yule atauawa, kwa sababu amesema maneno ya uasi dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, aliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri na kukukomboa kutoka katika nyumba ya watumwa, ili akugeuze kutoka katika njia ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuamuru uende ndani yake; hivyo utauondoa uovu katikati yako.
sw.B: Nabii huyo au mwota ndoto huyo lazima auawe, kwa sababu amechochea uasi dhidi ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, aliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri na kukukomboa kutoka katika nyumba ya utumwa. Amejaribu kukugeuza kutoka katika njia ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuamuru uifuate. Utauondoa uovu kati yako.
sw.R: Nabii huyo au mtu huyo anayeota ndoto lazima auawe. Amewaambia mmwasi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu. Ndiye aliyewatoa Misri na kukuweka huru kutoka katika utumwa huko. Mtu huyo alijaribu kukuongoza mbali na njia ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako alikuambia uishi. Unapaswa kuuondoa uovu ulio kati yako.

vi.L: Còn nhà tiên tri ấy hay kẻ nằm mơ thấy chiêm bao ấy phải bị xử tử, vì người ấy đã nói lời phản nghịch {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, Đấng đã đem các ngươi ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập và chuộc ngươi khỏi nhà nô lệ, để xô ngươi ra khỏi con đường {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đã truyền cho ngươi đi theo; như vậy ngươi phải loại trừ điều ác khỏi giữa ngươi.
vi.B: Nhà tiên tri hay người nằm mơ ấy phải bị xử tử, vì người ấy đã xúi giục phản nghịch {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, Đấng đã đem anh em ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập và chuộc anh em khỏi nhà nô lệ. Người ấy đã tìm cách kéo anh em ra khỏi con đường {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã truyền cho anh em đi theo. Anh em phải loại trừ điều ác khỏi giữa mình.
vi.R: Nhà tiên tri hay người nằm mơ ấy phải bị xử tử. Người ấy đã xúi anh em chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, là Đấng đã đem anh em ra khỏi Ai Cập và giải thoát anh em khỏi cảnh nô lệ ở đó. Người ấy đã tìm cách dẫn anh em đi khỏi con đường {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đã dạy anh em sống. Anh em phải diệt trừ điều ác ấy khỏi giữa mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그 예언자나 그 꿈꾸는 자는 죽임을 당해야 한다. 그가 너희를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내시고 종들의 집에서 너를 속량하신 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 반역하는 말을 하여, 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 걸어가라고 명령하신 길에서 너를 밀어내려 하였기 때문이다. 그러므로 너는 너희 가운데서 악을 없애 버려라.
ko.B: 그 예언자나 꿈꾸는 사람은 죽여야 한다. 그는 너희를 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내시고 종살이하던 집에서 너희를 값을 치르고 건져 내신 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 반역하라고 부추겼다. 그는 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너희에게 걸어가라고 명령하신 길에서 너희를 떠나게 하려고 하였다. 너희는 너희 가운데서 악을 없애 버려라.
ko.R: 그 예언자나 꿈을 꾸는 사람은 죽여야 합니다. 그는 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 등을 돌리라고 여러분에게 말했습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 여러분을 이집트에서 이끌어 내시고, 그곳에서 종살이하던 여러분을 풀어 주신 분입니다. 그 사람은 여러분의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여러분에게 살라고 명령하신 길에서 여러분을 벗어나게 하려고 했습니다. 여러분은 이런 악을 여러분 가운데서 없애 버려야 합니다.

pt.L: E aquele profeta ou aquele sonhador de sonhos será morto, pois falou rebelião contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que tirou vocês da terra do Egito e te resgatou da casa de escravos, para te desviar do caminho em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te ordenou andar; e eliminarás o mal do meio de ti.
pt.B: Aquele profeta ou sonhador deve ser morto, porque pregou a rebelião contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, que os tirou da terra do Egito e os resgatou da casa da escravidão. Ele tentou te desviar do caminho em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te ordenou andar. Eliminarás o mal do meio de ti.
pt.R: Aquele profeta ou sonhador deve ser morto. Ele disse a vocês que se voltassem contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês. Foi ele que tirou vocês do Egito e os libertou da escravidão. Aquele homem tentou te desviar do caminho que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, te mandou seguir. Deves eliminar o mal do meio de ti.

am.L: ያም ነቢይ ወይም ያ ሕልም አላሚ ይገደል፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣችሁ፣ ከባሪያዎችም ቤት በዋጀህ በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ ዓመፅን ተናግሯልና፣ አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ትሄድባት ዘንድ ካዘዘህ መንገድ ሊገፋህ፤ እንዲሁ ክፉውን ከመካከልህ ታስወግዳለህ።
am.B: ያ ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ይገደል፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ባወጣችሁና ከባርነት ቤት በዋጃችሁ በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ እንድታምፁ አነሣሥቷልና። አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንድትሄድበት ካዘዘህ መንገድ ሊያስትህ ሞክሯል። በዚህ መንገድ ክፉውን ከመካከልህ ታስወግዳለህ።
am.R: ያ ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ መገደል አለበት። በአምላካችሁ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ እንድታምፁ ነግሯችኋል። ከግብፅ ያወጣችሁና በዚያ ከነበራችሁበት ባርነት ነጻ ያወጣችሁ እርሱ ነው። ያ ሰው አምላክህ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንድትኖርበት ካዘዘህ መንገድ ሊያስትህ ሞክሯል። ክፉውን ከመካከልህ ማስወገድ ያለብህ በዚህ መንገድ ነው።

decisions.choice: spoken rebellion: urged a turning away from the LORD
decisions.reason: The noun means a turning aside, falling away, revolt. To "speak" it is to preach disloyalty to the LORD. The same charge is laid against false prophets in Jeremiah 28:16 and 29:32.

decisions.choice: redeemed: set free, as one released from bondage
decisions.reason: The verb means to free someone by paying or acting on their behalf. Deuteronomy uses it for the LORD's rescue of Israel from Egypt (7:8; 9:26; 15:15). The prophet calls Israel away from the very God who freed them.

decisions.choice: the house of slaves: Egypt, where Israel was held in slavery
decisions.reason: "House" here means the place or state of bondage. The phrase recalls the opening of the Ten Commandments (5:6; Exodus 20:2) and so the first command, to have no other gods.

decisions.choice: purge the evil from your midst: remove the wrong and the wrongdoer from the community
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn up and so to clear away completely. "The evil" may mean the evil deed or the evil person; the two go together, since the wrongdoer is put to death. The formula closes several laws in Deuteronomy (17:7, 12; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21-24; 24:7).

decisions.choice: house of slaves / house of slavery / being slaves
decisions.reason: This phrase speaks of Israel's real slavery in Egypt, so every level keeps the word "slave" or "slavery", as the house of slavery in Exodus 13:3 and 20:2 does.

decisions.choice: He has tried to
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "to thrust you aside" states the purpose of the prophet's words. Balanced and Readable make it a sentence of its own with "tried to"; Readable says "live" for "walk", the meaning of walking in a way.

decisions.choice: "quitarás el mal de en medio de ti" (L), "eliminarás el mal de en medio de ti" (B), "debes librarte del mal que hay entre los tuyos" (R); "de Israel" / "en Israel" where the Hebrew says "from Israel"
decisions.reason: The refrain closes laws through Deuteronomy (13:6 (13:5 in many English Bibles); 17:7, 12; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21, 22, 24; 24:7), and Spanish gives it one wording per level wherever it returns, with everyday verbs for clearing something away, as the English does with "purge", "remove" and "get rid of". The Hebrew singular "you" (Israel as one) is kept, so there is no plural_you span.

decisions.choice: "tu ôteras le mal du milieu de toi" (L), "tu feras disparaître le mal du milieu de toi" (B), "tu dois te débarrasser du mal qui est chez toi" (R); "d'Israël" / "en Israël" where the Hebrew says "from Israel"
alternatives: "tu brûleras le mal", after the verb's first sense
decisions.reason: The refrain closes laws through Deuteronomy (13:6 (13:5 in many English Bibles); 17:7, 12; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21, 22, 24; 24:7), and French gives it one wording per level wherever it returns, with everyday verbs for clearing something away, as the English does with "purge", "remove" and "get rid of". "Ôter" says "remove completely" without the picture of burning, which French would read literally. The Hebrew singular "you" (Israel as one) is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: "utauondoa uovu katikati yako" (L), "utauondoa uovu kati yako" (B), "unapaswa kuuondoa uovu ulio kati yako" (R); "katika Israeli" where the Hebrew says "from Israel"
alternatives: "utauteketeza uovu", after the verb's first sense, to burn
decisions.reason: The refrain closes laws through Deuteronomy (13:6 (13:5 in many English Bibles); 17:7, 12; 19:19; 21:21; 22:21, 22, 24; 24:7), and Swahili gives it one wording per level wherever it returns, keeping the one verb "kuondoa" at every level, as the English keeps "remove" and "get rid of". The Hebrew singular "you" (wewe) is kept.

decisions.choice: "너희 가운데서 악을 없애 버려라"
decisions.reason: The modern verb for the formula that recurs through the laws of Deuteronomy, rather than the older "제하다".

decisions.choice: "loại trừ điều ác khỏi giữa ngươi / mình" for purging the evil from your midst
decisions.reason: The refrain of Deuteronomy's laws, kept in the same words wherever it returns; Readable says "diệt trừ điều ác ấy".

decisions.choice: eliminarás o mal do meio de ti (L, B); deves eliminar o mal do meio de ti (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain (m4) in the wording 19:19 sets for the whole book; here the Hebrew is singular, so "do meio de ti".

decisions.choice: vocês (who brought you out) ... tu (to turn you aside; purge)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves from the plural to the singular inside the verse ("you" plural, then "redeemed you" singular). Literal follows it word by word; Balanced and Readable keep the first sentence in "vocês" and say "tu" from "Ele tentou te desviar" on. "Casa de escravos" (L) and "casa da escravidão" (B) as 5:6.

decisions.choice: "ዋጀ" for "redeemed"; "የባሪያዎች ቤት" (L), "የባርነት ቤት" (B), "ባርነት" (R); "እንዲሁ ክፉውን ከመካከልህ ታስወግዳለህ" (L), "በዚህ መንገድ ..." (B), "ክፉውን ከመካከልህ ማስወገድ ያለብህ በዚህ መንገድ ነው" (R) for "purge the evil from your midst"
decisions.reason: The settled choice for padah is "ዋጀ". The purge formula returns in later chapters; the same wording is used for it.

source.text: כִּ֣י יְסִֽיתְךָ֡ אָחִ֣יךָ בֶן־אִ֠מֶּךָ אֽוֹ־בִנְךָ֨ אֽוֹ־בִתְּךָ֜ א֣וֹ׀אֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיקֶ֗ךָ א֧וֹ רֵֽעֲךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּנַפְשְׁךָ֖ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר נֵֽלְכָ֗ה וְנַֽעַבְדָה֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If entices you your brother, [the] son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or [the] wife of your bosom or your friend who [is] like your soul, in secret, saying, let us go and let us serve other gods, which not you have known, you and your fathers,

en.L: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or the wife of your bosom or your friend who [is] like your own soul entices you in secret, saying, 'Let us go and let us serve other gods'—which you have not known, you or your fathers—
en.B: If your own brother, your mother's son, or your son or your daughter, or the wife you embrace, or the friend who is as dear to you as your own life, secretly entices you, saying, 'Let us go and worship other gods'—gods that neither you nor your ancestors have known,
en.R: Someone very close to you may try to lead you astray in secret. It may be your brother, your son or your daughter, the wife you love, or your dearest friend. That person may say, 'Let us go and worship other gods.' These are gods that you and your ancestors have never known.

es.L: Si te incita en secreto tu hermano, el hijo de tu madre, o tu hijo o tu hija o la mujer de tu seno o tu amigo que [es] como tu propia alma, diciendo: “Vayamos y sirvamos a otros dioses” —que no has conocido, ni tú ni tus padres—,
es.B: Si tu propio hermano, el hijo de tu madre, o tu hijo o tu hija, o la esposa que abrazas, o el amigo que te es tan querido como tu propia vida, te incita en secreto, diciendo: “Vayamos a adorar a otros dioses” —dioses desconocidos para ti y para tus antepasados—,
es.R: Puede ser que alguien muy cercano a ti intente desviarte en secreto. Puede ser tu hermano, tu hijo o tu hija, la esposa que amas o tu mejor amigo. Esa persona quizá te diga: “Vayamos a adorar a otros dioses”. Tú nunca has conocido a esos dioses, ni tampoco tus antepasados.

fr.L: Si ton frère, le fils de ta mère, ou ton fils ou ta fille ou la femme de ton sein ou ton ami qui [est] comme ton âme t’incite en secret, en disant : “Allons et servons d’autres dieux” — que tu n’as pas connus, ni toi ni tes pères —
fr.B: Si ton propre frère, le fils de ta mère, ou ton fils ou ta fille, ou la femme que tu serres dans tes bras, ou l’ami qui t’est aussi cher que ta propre vie, cherche en secret à t’entraîner en disant : “Allons adorer d’autres dieux” — des dieux que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’avez connus,
fr.R: Quelqu’un de très proche de toi essaiera peut-être de t’égarer en secret. Ce sera peut-être ton frère, ton fils ou ta fille, la femme que tu aimes, ou ton meilleur ami. Cette personne te dira peut-être : “Allons adorer d’autres dieux.” Ce sont des dieux que ni toi ni tes ancêtres n’avez jamais connus.

sw.L: Ndugu yako, mwana wa mama yako, au mwanao au binti yako au mke wa kifuani mwako au rafiki yako aliye kama nafsi yako akikushawishi kwa siri, akisema, 'Na twende tukaitumikie miungu mingine'—ambayo hukuijua, wewe wala baba zako—
sw.B: Ikiwa ndugu yako mwenyewe, mwana wa mama yako, au mwanao au binti yako, au mke unayemkumbatia, au rafiki unayempenda kama maisha yako mwenyewe, atakushawishi kwa siri, akisema, 'Twende tukaiabudu miungu mingine'—miungu ambayo wewe wala mababu zako hamkuijua,
sw.R: Huenda mtu wa karibu sana nawe akajaribu kukupotosha kwa siri. Huenda akawa ndugu yako, mwanao au binti yako, mke unayempenda, au rafiki yako mpendwa kuliko wote. Mtu huyo anaweza kusema, 'Twende tukaiabudu miungu mingine.' Hiyo ni miungu ambayo wewe na mababu zako hamjawahi kuijua.

vi.L: Nếu anh em ngươi, con trai của mẹ ngươi, hoặc con trai ngươi, con gái ngươi, người vợ ngươi ấp ủ, hay bạn thân như chính mạng sống ngươi, lén lút dụ dỗ ngươi mà nói: 'Chúng ta hãy đi phụng sự các thần khác'—là các thần mà ngươi và tổ phụ ngươi chưa biết—
vi.B: Nếu chính người anh em ruột, con trai của mẹ mình, hay con trai, con gái mình, hay người vợ mình yêu dấu, hay người bạn quý như mạng sống mình, lén lút dụ dỗ anh em mà nói: 'Chúng ta hãy đi thờ phụng các thần khác'—những thần mà cả anh em lẫn tổ tiên anh em chưa từng biết—
vi.R: Có thể một người rất gần gũi với anh em sẽ lén lút tìm cách dụ dỗ anh em. Đó có thể là anh em ruột, con trai hay con gái, người vợ anh em yêu thương, hay người bạn thân nhất của anh em. Người ấy có thể nói: 'Chúng ta hãy đi thờ các thần khác.' Đó là những thần mà anh em và tổ tiên anh em chưa từng biết.

ko.L: 네 어머니의 아들인 네 형제나, 네 아들이나 네 딸이나, 네 품의 아내나, 네 목숨과 같은 네 친구가 은밀히 너를 꾀어 '우리가 가서 다른 신들을 섬기자' 하고 말하면, —너도 네 조상들도 알지 못하던 것들이다—
ko.B: 한 어머니에게서 난 너의 형제나, 너의 아들이나 딸이나, 너의 사랑하는 아내나, 너의 목숨처럼 소중한 친구가 은밀히 너를 꾀어 '우리가 가서 다른 신들을 섬기자' 하고 말하더라도, —그것은 너도 너의 조상들도 알지 못하던 신들이다—
ko.R: 여러분과 아주 가까운 사람이 몰래 여러분을 꾀어 낼 수도 있습니다. 여러분의 형제나 아들이나 딸이나 사랑하는 아내나 가장 친한 친구가 그럴 수 있습니다. 그 사람이 '우리 가서 다른 신들을 섬기자' 하고 말할 수도 있습니다. 그 신들은 여러분도 여러분의 조상들도 알지 못하던 신들입니다.

pt.L: Se te seduzir em segredo o teu irmão, filho da tua mãe, ou o teu filho, ou a tua filha, ou a mulher do teu seio, ou o teu amigo que [é] como a tua alma, dizendo: 'Vamos e sirvamos outros deuses' — que não conheceste, nem tu nem os teus pais —
pt.B: Se o teu próprio irmão, filho da tua mãe, ou o teu filho ou a tua filha, ou a mulher que abraças, ou o amigo que te é tão querido como a tua própria vida, te seduzir em segredo, dizendo: 'Vamos adorar outros deuses' — deuses que nem tu nem os teus antepassados conheceram,
pt.R: Alguém muito próximo de ti pode tentar te desviar em segredo. Pode ser o teu irmão, o teu filho ou a tua filha, a esposa que amas ou o teu melhor amigo. Essa pessoa pode dizer: 'Vamos adorar outros deuses.' São deuses que nem tu nem os teus antepassados conheceram.

am.L: የእናትህ ልጅ ወንድምህ፣ ወይም ወንድ ልጅህ፣ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ፣ ወይም በዕቅፍህ ያለችው ሚስትህ፣ ወይም እንደ ነፍስህ የሆነው ባልንጀራህ፦ “እንሂድ፤ ሌሎችን አማልክት እናገልግል” ብሎ በስውር ቢያስትህ—አንተም አባቶችህም ያላወቃችኋቸውን [አማልክት]—
am.B: የእናትህ ልጅ የሆነው የገዛ ወንድምህ፣ ወንድ ልጅህ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ፣ የምታቅፋት ሚስትህ ወይም እንደ ነፍስህ የምትወደው ጓደኛህ፦ “እንሂድ፤ ሌሎችን አማልክት እናምልክ” ብሎ በስውር ቢያስትህ፣ እነርሱም አንተም ሆንክ አባቶችህ የማታውቋቸው አማልክት፣
am.R: በጣም የቅርብህ የሆነ ሰው በስውር ሊያስትህ ይሞክር ይሆናል። ወንድምህ፣ ወንድ ልጅህ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ፣ የምትወዳት ሚስትህ ወይም የልብ ጓደኛህ ሊሆን ይችላል። ያ ሰው “እንሂድ፤ ሌሎችን አማልክት እናምልክ” ይልህ ይሆናል። እነዚህ አንተም አባቶችህም ከቶ የማታውቋቸው አማልክት ናቸው።

decisions.choice: your brother, the son of your mother (Hebrew text)
alternatives: your brother, the son of your father or the son of your mother
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "your brother, the son of your mother". The ancient Greek translation and the Samaritan text read "your brother, the son of your father or the son of your mother", which may be a fuller original or an expansion to cover half brothers on both sides. Reviewers should check the evidence. The sense is the same: even the closest relative.

decisions.choice: the son of your mother: a full brother, the closest of brothers
decisions.reason: In a household where a man might have children by more than one wife (21:15), a brother by the same mother was the nearest kin. The list that follows goes from close to closer still: son, daughter, wife, dearest friend.

decisions.choice: the wife of your bosom: the wife you hold close
decisions.reason: The phrase pictures the wife held in her husband's arms, his most intimate companion (28:54; Micah 7:5).

decisions.choice: your friend who is like your own soul: a friend as dear to you as your own life
decisions.reason: The "soul" here is the self or life. Jonathan loved David "as his own soul" (1 Samuel 18:1, 3).

decisions.choice: which you have not known, you or your fathers: Moses' comment again, as in verse 3
decisions.reason: These words speak to the hearer directly and break into the invitation, as in verse 3. They add that not even the ancestors had any dealings with these gods.

decisions.choice: the wife you embrace; the friend who is as dear to you as your own life
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the two Hebrew pictures mean in plain words; Literal keeps "the wife of your bosom" and "like your own soul".

decisions.choice: Someone very close to you may try to lead you astray in secret.
decisions.reason: Readable states the case first and then lists the people who may be meant, so the long Hebrew sentence becomes several short ones. It leaves out "your mother's son", which only stresses how close the brother is.

decisions.choice: "너" at B in this case law
decisions.reason: At Balanced, the laws about what one person must do in his own household keep the singular "너", since the case concerns each Israelite's brother, wife and friend (see the register decision at 7:1).

decisions.choice: "anh em ruột" for "your brother, the son of your mother"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the full brother plainly; Balanced keeps "con trai của mẹ mình" beside it. The singular address "anh em" for the reader and "anh em ruột" for the brother are told apart by "ruột".

decisions.choice: a mulher do teu seio; o teu amigo que [é] como a tua alma

decisions.choice: "በዕቅፍህ ያለችው ሚስትህ" (L), "የምታቅፋት ሚስትህ" (B), "የምትወዳት ሚስትህ" (R); "እንደ ነፍስህ የሆነው ባልንጀራህ" (L), "እንደ ነፍስህ የምትወደው ጓደኛህ" (B), "የልብ ጓደኛህ" (R)

decisions.reason: The phrase covers the whole world from one edge to the other, as in 28:64.

decisions.choice: from one end of the earth to the other / anywhere in the world

decisions.choice: ao teu redor, de ti (tu throughout at B, R)

decisions.choice: him: the one who entices, whether man or woman
decisions.reason: The pronoun is masculine, as Hebrew uses for a person in general, but the enticer of verse 7 may be a daughter or a wife as well as a brother, son or friend.

decisions.choice: your eye shall not pity him: you must not let feeling for him hold you back
decisions.reason: The eye is where pity shows; the phrase recurs in Deuteronomy's hardest laws (7:16; 19:13, 21; 25:12). Love for a relative must not outweigh loyalty to the LORD.

decisions.choice: cover over him: shield him by hiding what he did
decisions.reason: To "cover" here is to keep the matter secret and so protect the person. The enticing was done "in secret" (verse 7); it is not to stay secret.

decisions.choice: them / that person, with "him" as the alternative
decisions.reason: Because the enticer may be a woman or a man, Balanced and Readable use the inclusive form by default with "him" as the reader's alternative. Literal keeps the Hebrew pronoun "him".

decisions.choice: feel sorry for; hide what they did
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two Hebrew pictures mean: "your eye shall not pity" is to feel sorry, and "cover over" is to hide the deed.

decisions.choice: {{gender:esa persona|ese hombre}}, then "la" / "ella" (alternative "lo" / "él")
decisions.reason: Spanish pronouns show gender, so the inclusive default names "esa persona" and agrees with it; the setting gives "ese hombre" and the masculine forms, as in English. Verses 10-11 follow the same pattern.

decisions.choice: {{gender:cette personne|cet homme}}, then "elle" / "la" (alternative "lui" / "le")
decisions.reason: French pronouns show gender, so the inclusive default names "cette personne" and then agrees with it; the setting gives "cet homme" and the masculine pronouns, as the English setting gives "him". The same pattern runs through verses 10-11.

decisions.choice: "그 사람", "그" with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English offers "them / that person" with "him" as the alternative; Korean "그 사람" already covers a man or a woman, and "그" is used here as the plain third person for either, so no span is needed.

decisions.choice: "người ấy" / "người đó" with no gender span
decisions.reason: These words already mean the person, man or woman, so Vietnamese needs no second wording for the English "them" / "him" setting; the same holds in verses 10-11.

decisions.choice: essa pessoa ... dela ... a, with ele ... dele ... o as the alternative
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): the enticer may be a woman as well as a man (m1), so Balanced and Readable name "essa pessoa" by default, with the traditional masculine as the alternative; the pronouns that agree with it go under the same setting. Literal keeps the Hebrew "ele", as the English Literal keeps "him".

decisions.choice: o teu olho não terá piedade dele
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, as 7:16 and 19:13 do in Portuguese (m2).

decisions.choice: No gender span on the one who entices: "ያ ሰው" and the masculine suffixes, through verse 11
decisions.reason: Amharic's generic "ሰው" with the masculine suffix already includes a woman (the enticer may be a daughter or a wife, verse 7), so the English span has nothing to change.
